##

My goal: make quarto superior to keynote, powerpoint, and google slides

##

Introducting quarto-revealjs-editable :tada:

::: fragment

::: {.columns}

::: {.column}

User has to:

- add class to image
- move it around
- click save button
- save and overwrite file
- hit render

:::

::: {.column}

Editable has to:

0. inject all of source document into the slides
1. finds all moved images
2. updates the source document with new x and y

1 & 2 done using regex

:::
